requirements.note: Blue right / grey left bubbles, oldest first, opens at newest. Headings appear where the day changes, but they read like timestamps ('Jul 3, 2026 at 4:20 PM') rather than day headings.
Send appends, stays at bottom, clears composer; send disabled for empty and whitespace-only text.
Composer rides the keyboard; newest messages remain visible above it.
'Sam is typing…' grey bubble, then a canned reply ('Sure thing') ~2 s later.
Long-press opens system context menu with lifted preview: Copy (pastes correctly) and Delete (persists across relaunch).
Reaches message 1 smoothly; a 'Newest messages' chevron button appears when scrolled up and returns to bottom.
Sent messages and Sam's replies survive relaunch.

tells: Composer is a two-line-tall box when empty with the placeholder pinned top-left rather than a single-line capsule with vertically centred placeholder
Day headings include a clock time ('Jul 1, 2026 at 3:20 AM') – reads as a timestamp, not a Messages-style day separator
Typing indicator is plain 'Sam is typing…' text in a bubble, no animated dots
Jump-to-newest button is a small 35pt chevron that sits on top of bubbles; at largest text it overlaps message text
A.scroll: Scrolls smoothly from newest to the first message with flings and slow drags; no blank rows, jumps or pop-in observed, scroll indicator behaves natively.

requirements.note: Right/left bubbles, oldest first, opens at newest; Messages-style bold day headings ('Wed, Jul 1', 'Today').
Send appends, stays at bottom, clears composer; send disabled for empty/whitespace.
Composer stays above keyboard; newest messages visible.
Animated three-dot bubble with 'Sam is typing…' caption, then canned reply ('On it!') ~2 s later.
System context menu with lifted bubble: Copy (pastes correctly), Delete (persists across relaunch).
Reaches message 1 smoothly; a 58pt glass 'Jump to newest message' button appears once scrolled up and works.
Sent messages and replies survive relaunch.

tells: Send button is a separate grey circle outside the text field instead of inside the field like Messages
Avatar/name header does not scale with Dynamic Type (acceptable for a nav title, but the composer's send button also stays small at largest size)
Jump-to-newest button overlaps bubbles at largest text size
B.scroll: Smooth through all 520 messages to the first; flings and slow drags feel native with no blank rows or jumps.

why: Both apps meet every requirement with native context menus, keyboard handling, persistence and smooth scrolling. B looks more like Messages: bold day separators, an animated typing-dots bubble, an avatar header and a single-line composer. A's composer is an oversized two-line box, its day headings read as timestamps, and its typing indicator is plain text.
